title: Universal Semantic Logger Schema
description: Framework-agnostic semantic logging schema. Context types and their schemas are defined by applications, not by this logging framework

mode.description: The logger mode that produced this document. Recorded so the document is self-describing about its own evidential value: in a total-mode document the absence of diagnostic entries is proof of a clean session, while a document without mode carries no such proof. Optional in 0.9.x; planned to become required in 1.0.

open.description: Top-level root operations in chronological order. Each entry may carry nested child opens, nested events, and its matching close.

close.description: Top-level orphan close entries that could not be nested under a matching open entry.

events.description: Top-level root-scope or orphan events that could not be nested under a matching open entry.

type.description: Application-defined event type (e.g., cache_operation, database_query, external_api)

context.description: Application-specific event data conforming to the referenced schema

links.description: Web Links for semantic relationships - extends JSON Schema with hypermedia concepts for AI understanding. While not part of JSON Schema specification, these links provide semantic context and relationships between log entries, following RFC 8288 Web Linking principles. Enables AI to understand contextual relationships, dependencies, and semantic connections that pure data structure cannot express

rel.description: Link relationship type following RFC 8288 Web Linking

title.description: Human-readable title for the link relationship

type.description: Media type hint for the linked resource

examples.title: External API failure that triggered this error

openEntry.description: Application-defined open context with optional nested child opens, nested events, and its matching close.

type.description: Application-defined context type (e.g., http_request, database_query, business_logic)

context.description: Application-specific context data conforming to the referenced schema

events.description: Events that occurred while this operation was active.

close.description: The matching close entry for this open operation. Omitted when the operation is unclosed.

open.description: Nested child operations in chronological order.

eventEntry.description: Application-defined event context. Nested events omit openId because scope is implied by structural placement; top-level orphan/root events may still carry openId for diagnostics.

context.description: Application-specific event data conforming to the referenced schema

closeEntry.description: Application-defined close context. Nested matched closes omit openId because the matching open is implied by structural placement; orphan closes may still carry openId for diagnostics.

type.description: Application-defined context type (e.g., http_response, database_result, business_complete)

context.description: Application-specific context data conforming to the referenced schema

profile.description: Observed profiling data attributed to this specific operation. Present only when an attached profiler captured external Xdebug or XHProf output for this close.

operationId.description: Unique operation identifier following semantic naming convention: {type}_{sequence_number}

openIdReference.description: References a parent operation ID for hierarchical correlation - establishes position within operation tree. Creates parent-child relationships enabling complete request flow analysis and performance attribution

contextType.description: Context type identifier. The semantic_logger_* namespace is reserved for core diagnostics and placeholders; applications define other types through individual schema files.

operationProfile.description: Observed profiling data for a single operation (open/close pair). The profile object is emitted only when external profiler output was captured.

wallTime.description: Wall time for this operation in seconds under the instrumentation mode that produced this profile

xdebugTrace.description: Per-segment Xdebug trace file references captured while this operation was active. Omitted when no Xdebug trace output was captured.

path.description: Path to the Xdebug trace file on disk for this segment (a .gz suffix indicates a gzip-compressed trace)

xhprofProfile.description: Per-segment XHProf snapshot file references captured while this operation was active. Omitted when no XHProf output was captured.

path.description: Path to the XHProf snapshot file on disk for this segment

oneOf.description: Relative path to local schema file

schemaUrl.description: Context schema reference for AI-human understanding alignment. While humans naturally understand what this context represents, AI needs explicit schema guidance to achieve the same level of comprehension about data structure, constraints, and business meaning. Supports both absolute URLs and relative file paths.
schemaUrl.$comment: Bridge: Humans intuitively understand context meaning; AI uses this schema reference to gain equivalent understanding.
